gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-tamil-s: Metamorphous carries a commanding look, with generous sidebearings and a mild pen-like shift in stroke weight. But Noto Sans Tamil Supplement wins me over with round forms that curve like open parentheses.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-tc: Metamorphous spaces its letters generously, with a soft fat-slim stroke shift. Noto Sans TC then carries the text with large open counters and outward-opening curves, so extended reading goes down smoothly.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-telugu: Noto Sans Telugu keeps its midline high and its counters connected to the outside. Noto Sans Telugu stays quiet beside Metamorphous, which earns its keep big and short, where its commanding strokes show.

gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-vithkuq: Metamorphous brings a commanding, distinctive look, its fat and slim strokes close enough to feel related to each other. Noto Sans Vithkuqi does the quiet work, with open throats.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-warang-: Generous sidebearings give Metamorphous a spaced, commanding look, with a comfortable midpoint between flat strokes and dramatic ones. Give Noto Sans Warang Citi modest sizes and its words form solid blocks.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-yi: Metamorphous sets a commanding tone with large sidebearings and a restrained fat-slim look in every glyph. Noto Sans Yi backs it with a deep lowercase midsection and rounds left unsealed, like an unlatched hook.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-parkinsans: A soft swell in stroke weight, like a lightly pressed brush, gives Metamorphous its commanding, distinctive character. Parkinsans draws constant, blueprint-like lines that stay crisp when shrunk down small.
